description: Use this when an agent needs Bitcoin data (BTC/USD, fees, mining, sentiment). kind="intuitive" (default; also get_bitcoin_price): multi-source price; kind="stats": fees, mempool, mining; kind="pro": stats plus hashprice/fee-share trends; kind="signals": Fear & Greed, RSI 7/14/21, SMA 20/50/200, momentum. Every kind includes the price BitScore and the BitTuition BTC mood. Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: intuitive (5 sats or $0.003 USDC), stats (17 sats or $0.01 USDC), pro (33 sats or $0.02 USDC), signals (33 sats or $0.02 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).
